project.title: Succession of a founding microbiome after seeding in an anaerobic baffled bioreactor for domestic wastewater treatment
project.description: Two anaerobic baffled reactors (ABR-1 and ABR-2) for primary treatment of domestic wastewater were characterized for microbial community structure over time in each reactor compartment using 16S rRNA gene sequencing.
